⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Number of PCM samples per channel produced by decoding a single [`components.AudioChunk`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_chunk?speculative-link).

Kept as an explicit column so that the viewer and downstream queries do
not need to decode the payload to know its span. For Opus this is
typically `sample_rate * frame_size_ms / 1000` (e.g. 480 samples for 20 ms
at 24 kHz).
